NOTICE
It is notified for information of all the candidates who have applied for the post of Research
Investigator in Population Research Centre advertised vide Advertisement Notice No. 15 of 2026,
dated 08.05.2026, that the list of candidates along with their eligibility status is given in Annexure-I to
this notice. In view of the insufficient number of eligible candidates required for the post as per
notice dated 17.12.2025, the post will be re-advertised.
By order,
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
Recruitment
No. F/NT-PRC-RI-ReAdv-II/KU/26
Dated: 12.08.2026
Copy to the: -
1. Special Secretary to the Vice Chancellor for information of the Hon’ble Vice
Chancellor;
2. I/C Director IT&SS, with the request to please ensure that the Notice is uploaded
on the University website.
3. P.A. to Registrar for information of the Registrar;
4. File
